author: CNN
description:
Saudi Arabia has drawn two of the Muslim world’s most formidable military powers into its defense as the Iran war moves closer to the kingdom. Pakistan and Turkey signed a NATO-style mutual defense pact with Saudi Arabia in Mecca on Friday, consolidating their longstanding security ties into a collective-defense alliance that stipulates an attack against any of them “shall be regarded as attack on them all.”

That commitment could draw Pakistan and Turkey into a war they have carefully kept at arm’s length. A senior Iranian official warned the pact will not guarantee Saudi Arabia’s security.

description:
Around 50,000 migrants crossed into Spain’s North African exclave of Ceuta this week, a mass influx that overwhelmed local authorities. At least 57 people died during the crossings, which prompted tighter border security measures across Europe.

Spanish leaders said they were working to expel all those who had entered as quickly as possible, and said by Friday evening that most migrants had been returned to neighboring Morocco. Many had returned voluntarily after failing to find food or shelter in Ceuta.

Fareed Zakaria, host of CNN's "Fareed Zakaria GPS", reacts to the migrant crisis and explains its origins.

description:
A divided federal appeals court ruled Friday that President Donald Trump is unlawfully constructing a massive new ballroom at the White House, possibly teeing up a high-stakes showdown over the issue before the Supreme Court. 

“Whether or not a massive ballroom should be constructed is for Congress to decide and is not a matter for Executive self-help,” the DC Circuit Court of Appeals said in a 2-1 ruling siding with the nation’s top historic preservation group, which sued over the project last year. 

CNN's Kristen Holmes has the latest details from the White House. Also, CNN's Phil Mattingly discusses whether the ruling will lead to Trump needing congressional approval to continue the project.

author: CNN
description:
GOP Sen. Bill Cassidy said Friday that he will support Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general, clearing the way for his narrow confirmation to the high-profile role. 

The Louisiana Republican’s decision comes after weeks of scrutiny of Blanche’s actions that had thrown his candidacy into doubt, and will hand a major victory to President Donald Trump and his senior aides. 

Blanche could not afford to lose Cassidy’s vote after GOP Sens. Lisa Murkowski and Susan Collins pledged to vote against him, leaving him unable to lose another vote for his Senate confirmation.

description:
Several people, including children, have been killed after a teenage gunman opened fire at his school on the outskirts of Bangkok on Friday. 

Images show children running out of the Debsirin Nonthaburi School and emergency personnel gathering at the scene, helping those who were wounded. 

One unnamed rescue worker told the Reuters news agency that “it was total chaos” when they arrived at the scene, where they administered first aid to students who had wounds to their back, chest and arms. 

CNN's Kristie Lu Stout has the details and Karla Cripps, a CNN producer whose son attends Debsirin Nonthaburi but was not at the scene at the time of the shooting, reports from outside the school.
